blogs.title: Stop Feeding Data to LLMs: How AI Can Now Act as Your Feature Engineer
blogs.description: Explore how the new FeatLLM framework shifts the role of Large Language Models from slow, expensive predictors to smart 'feature engineers.' Learn how this approach uses AI to generate human-readable rules from tabular data, allowing simple, fast models to make accurate predictions without needing to query the LLM for every single new data point.

blogs.title: Few-Shot Learning Revolution: Beating Complex Models with Just a Few Examples
blogs.description: Discover how FeatLLM tackles the 'few-shot' problem in data science, where labeled data is scarce. This post breaks down how leveraging an LLM's prior knowledge to extract decision rules allows for high-accuracy predictions on tasks like disease diagnosis and credit risk assessment using only a handful of training examples, outperforming traditional deep learning baselines.

blogs.title: Solving the Context Window Crisis: How Bagging Makes LLMs Work with Massive Datasets
blogs.description: One of the biggest hurdles for using AI on spreadsheets is the 'context limit'—LLMs can't read infinite columns at once. This article explains how FeatLLM uses a clever 'bagging' technique to break down large datasets into manageable chunks, generating diverse rule sets that are ensembled together to overcome prompt size limitations and handle complex, wide tables.

blogs.title: From Black Box to White Box: Why Rule-Based AI is Better for Business Decisions
blogs.description: Why should businesses trust an AI that can't explain its reasoning? We dive into the interpretability of FeatLLM, which generates explicit 'if-then' rules (e.g., 'If age > 60 AND cholesterol > X') rather than opaque neural network weights. See how this transparency helps filter out spurious correlations and builds trust in critical industries like healthcare and finance.
